name: io.github.singularitybpjade/balance-engine
title: Balance Engine · Deterministic Time Layer
description: Balance Engine business strategy tool: deterministic calendar & solar-term lookups for AI agents.

tools.name: today_rhythm
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 今天节奏怎么样 / 今天势能怎么样 / 今天是什么日子 / 今天适不适合签约开会发版 / 今天流通怎么样 / 该不该推进某事 / what is today's rhythm. First line is the #be time atom (keep the time atom in Chinese). Then east pillars, this month’s fold year (same pillar), month posture × west tightness, plus the daily west sky line. Always surface the fold-year line and ask what they lived that year. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or 时支 like 申 / 未时. Adds the public hour pillar. Use when the user says 现在 / 下午 / 几点.

tools.name: month_brief
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 这个月势能怎么样 / 这个月该打磨还是该收 / 这个月哪天发布 / 这个月节奏怎么样 / 本月基调 / 做不做某事 / 哪几天适合上线 / which days to publish. First line is the #be time atom (keep the time atom in Chinese). Then this month’s fold year (same pillar), baseline tone, and dated sky marks. Always surface the fold-year line and ask what they lived that year. Public · local · no API key.

tools.name: capacity_budget
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Layer 1 of 3 — call this FIRST when the user asks 这个月能同时做几件事 / 我能不能同时开三条线 / 该不该接新项目 / 手上还能加几件事 / 还想再开一条线行不行 / how many things can I take on right now / do I have bandwidth for one more project. Returns how many new fronts this segment can hold (1–3), the label, and the grounds — computed by a rules engine, not a model. It is a constraint, not a task list: it does NOT say what to do. For the next layer, call activity_window (which one to move) or month_brief (when). Public · local · no API key.

tools.name: solar_terms
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 二十四节气 / 今年节气表 / 白露是哪天 / 立春哪天 / 夏至冬至是什么时候 / 下一个节气 / 24 solar terms / when is White Dew / next solar term / jieqi. Returns the full 24-term table for any year 1900–2100: civil date + exact term-boundary time (Asia/Shanghai), plus the next upcoming term. Public · local · no API key.

tools.name: date_lookup
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks for a civil date 1900–2100: lunar date, day pillar, solar term, or 农历 / 阴历 / 节气 / lunar date / day pillar. Returns lunar date and ganzhi, then body (sleep/load) and this month’s fold year. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Any date 1900–2100.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or 时支 like 申. Adds the hour pillar.

tools.name: sky_window
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 未来两周有什么天象 / 新月哪天 / 日食哪天 / 接下来有没有逆行 / what sky events are coming. Lists dated L1 sky marks (new/full moon, eclipse, ingress, stations). Public · local · no API key. Max span 45 days.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: from + 14 days.

tools.name: body_rhythm
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 今晚要不要提前睡 / 今天该不该加练 / 现在这个时辰适不适合动 / body energy / train or rest. Public body-energy lookup from solar term + hour + month posture × sky tightness. Not a diagnosis. Adjust ≠ infuse energy. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or 时支 like 申. Pins the hour slot. Use when the user says 现在 / 下午 / 几点.

tools.name: energy_adjust
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 能量怎么调 / 个人今天该推还是该收 / 团队这周该不该硬上线 / personal vs company rhythm. Same engine, two seats: personal (sleep/load) or org (window push vs hold). Not HR scoring, not medical treatment. Public · local · no API key.

seat.description: personal (default) = body load/sleep. org = team window, push vs hold.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

month.description: Month YYYY-MM for the org seat. Default: current month.

hour.description: Optional hour for the personal seat (HH:MM or 时支).

tools.name: activity_window
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 今天什么时候适合运动 / 今天哪个时辰适合深工 / 什么时候开会 / 什么时候练 / 什么时候发版 / 什么时候该休息 / activity window / when to exercise. Maps month posture × twelve hours × body load to 2–3 clock windows for task=deep_work|train|meet|ship|rest. Windows are suggested slots, not a guarantee. Not meds, not glucose, not a diagnosis. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

task.description: What to place: deep_work (default), train, meet, ship, rest.

tools.name: time_fold
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 时间折叠 / 现在叠的是哪一年 / 这个月对应哪一年 / time folding / nonlinear time / 甲午月是哪一年. First line is the #be time atom (keep the time atom in Chinese). Then this month’s fold year (same pillar). Ask the user what they lived that year — do not invent a biography. Then the Wuhu group and next year’s full table when the year is about to change. Then the 12-row table. Same table for everyone. A birth date only places the chapter. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

month.description: Month YYYY-MM if not passing date. Pins the flow-month.

compact.description: true = return only the atom line, fold mapping and rule line (token-light for chained agent calls). Default false = full 12-row table.

tools.name: people_roster
tools.description: This tool reads a user-named people roster. Do not invent people or merge two ids. Same role ≠ same person. Call when the user names a person, asks 这个人是谁 / 西交和宁波是不是同一个 / 花名册 / people roster, or before telling a story that involves named people. Pass people=[{name, relation, id?}] from what the user just said. If empty, ask the user to name people (name + one-line relation) — do not invent a biography. Optional env PEOPLE_ROSTER_JSON when the user keeps a local roster. Not L1. Public · no API key.

people.description: This-turn roster. Wins over PEOPLE_ROSTER_JSON. Omit to read the env roster.

relation.description: One-line relation in the user's words.

id.description: Stable id if the user already has one. Do not merge two ids.

tools.name: personal_day
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 我今天怎么样 / 我今天下午适不适合见面 / 未时基调 / 我今天的状态和今天什么关系 / my day. Personalized: day-master vs today's stem, plus an optional hour pillar. Requires BALANCE_API_KEY + birth profile. Empty key → error personal_timetable_requires_key; use free tools instead. Calendar lookup.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Use when the user asks about a specific day.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or earthly branch 子–亥 (e.g. 14:30 or 未). Adds the hour pillar.

birth.description: Optional birth profile. If omitted, uses the cloud profile saved on your account.

time.description: Birth time HH:MM (local civil time on the birth certificate)

city.description: Birth city name, or pass longitude+latitude instead

tools.name: personal_month
tools.description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks 我这个月怎么样 / 我哪周该推进 / 我这个月适不适合上线 / my month. Personalized flow-month: day-master vs month stem, dated sky, sandbox assumptions, fold-memory prompts. Requires BALANCE_API_KEY + birth profile. Empty key → error personal_timetable_requires_key; use free tools instead. Calendar lookup.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD to pin which flow month to use.

birth.description: Optional birth profile. If omitted, uses the cloud profile saved on your account.

time.description: Birth time HH:MM (local civil time on the birth certificate)

city.description: Birth city name, or pass longitude+latitude instead
